tabs.label: Vor dem Vortrag
tabs.instructions: Preparing makes the talk better. Check these points.
text:
• Thema: one clear topic.
  • Struktur: introduction, main part, conclusion.
  • Folien: short, with few words.
  • Üben: say it aloud and check the time.

tabs.label: Beim Vortrag
tabs.instructions: Speaking in front of others needs a calm tone.
text:
• Greet formally: Liebe Kolleginnen und Kollegen or Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren.
  • Look at your audience, not only at the screen.
  • Pause after each point.
  • End with Vielen Dank für Ihre Aufmerksamkeit.
